summary.intent: Update the codebase map documents (primarily CONCERNS.md) to reflect work completed in phases 28-33, then publish the changes as a PR.
summary.outcome: CONCERNS.md and STRUCTURE.md were updated on a new branch `docs/update-codebase-map`, with 4 concerns marked resolved and 3 new concerns surfaced, then merged into a PR (FSM1/cipher-box#390) with two follow-up stale-content fixes.

repo: Phase 28 removed the legacy POC directory (commit ee9bcd4e4) and replaced 127 console.* calls with a structured logger at apps/web/src/lib/logger.ts
Phase 30 added Grafana Faro observability (apps/web/src/lib/faro.ts) and Prometheus metrics (apps/api/src/metrics/), deployed via VITE_FARO_URL in staging CI
Phase 31 decomposed useSharedNavigation.ts (1199→378 lines) and FileBrowser.tsx (964→362 lines) into 6 focused hooks/helpers
Phase 32 resolved async FilePointer on macOS; Phase 33 completed the Windows counterpart in crates/fuse/src/platform/windows/read_ops.rs using rt.spawn() channel patterns
registerFaroTransport() is defined but never called, so logger.error/warn calls do not reach Faro
apps/web/src/lib/web3auth/hooks.ts retains 12 console.time/timeEnd calls not covered by Phase 28 logging migration
19+ mutex lock().unwrap() sites exist in FUSE production code, risking cascading panics on mutex poisoning
IPNS unenrollment is fire-and-forget via SDK with no persistence across tab closure
folder.service.ts (1059 lines) and bin.service.ts (971 lines) remain large but are considered logically cohesive enough to not warrant immediate decomposition

code.finding: Legacy POC concern was stale — POC directory was removed in Phase 28 (commit ee9bcd4e4) and no longer exists
Docker host IP reference was stale and unnecessary as of the current codebase state

workflow: The GSD map-codebase workflow supports selective document updates — useful when only specific concerns or structure has changed rather than a full remap
Mapper agents return only confirmations and line counts to the orchestrator, keeping orchestrator context minimal
When diverged from origin mid-session, the pattern used was: stash the new file to /tmp, hard-reset to origin/main, restore the stash — preserving agent-written work without an orphaned commit
Running concerns mapping twice (before and after pulling Phase 33) was necessary to get accurate resolution status for the Windows FilePointer fix

friction: Initial git pull failed with 'divergent branches' because the local commit (from the first concerns pass) had not been pushed before origin advanced with Phase 33
The first CONCERNS.md pass was rendered partially stale immediately after completion because Phase 33 merged while the agent was running
The mapper agent did not catch the stale legacy POC concern or the stale Docker host IP reference — required manual review and correction after the PR was created
open_items: 12 residual console.time/timeEnd calls in apps/web/src/lib/web3auth/hooks.ts need to be migrated to the structured logger
registerFaroTransport() needs to be wired up so logger.error/warn calls are forwarded to Grafana Faro
19+ mutex lock().unwrap() sites in FUSE production code should be replaced with proper error handling to avoid cascading panics
IPNS unenrollment fire-and-forget pattern has no persistence across tab closure — needs a persistence or retry strategy
folder.service.ts (1059 lines) and bin.service.ts (971 lines) are candidates for future decomposition analogous to Phase 31
